title: Find the names of all Italian-translated cards that are legal in the Comman
question: Find the names of all Italian-translated cards that are legal in the Commander format and have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), where the card's set also contains at least one card with converted mana cost of 6 or higher.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_049
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND c.XCL_063 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_063
    FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE c2.XCL_011 >= 6
  )
